notes.title: V2.1 Fishing more types of fish and important fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fishing more types of fish, and there is even a chance to catch other items that are not fish, such as gold.
[*] Add empty bottles to inventory after drinking water, and no longer consume bottles.
[*] Fixed the ambient sounds such as wind and waves not being controlled by the ambient sound settings.
[*] Fixed the problem that the float cannot float on the sea surface after casting the fishing rod.
[*] Added the ability to craft fishing rod and make bait from raw meat to the player's crafting list. Of course, you can also use a shovel to dig bait on the grass. Previously, you could only make fishing rods through the crafting table.
[*] Increased the probability of fish biting the hook when fishing within a certain period of time. Usually, there will be fish biting the hook within 2 minutes. Please wait patiently. There is a certain probability of unhooking, so when you miss the float floating, please consume a 1 bait cast rod again to fish.
[*] Fixed the problem that the fishing line is too transparent to see clearly.
[*] Set to dig sand from the grassland, which solves the problem that sand cannot be dug inland on the Australian map.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2 Hatching eggs, raising chickens
notes.content:
[h2]Hatching eggs and raising chickens[/h2]
You need to buy eggs from the NPC, and you can also put the eggs into the chicken coop you built. You can see the hatching progress prompt above it. Waiting for the eggs to hatch, you can see a cute little yellow chicken next to the  chicken coop.  It takes 20 minutes for an egg to hatch into a chick, and it takes 60 minutes for the chick to grow up. The probability of becoming a hen is 80%, and the probability of becoming a rooster is 20%. The rooster is aggressive and may attack you or other rooster  when you are close to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/2eb435a36b56700bce772a12bc43899ccc2319bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/c325709987597a0e45c7192872f893503f7c3dd9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/d6a73fe6c80e9c9685dd956d18af0d44861dbc28.jpg[/img]
The hen can lay eggs. Note that there must be a rooster near the hen before they can lay eggs. The egg laying time is once every 20 minutes, and you will see the laying egg progress bar of the hen., the eggs will fall to the ground, please pay attention to the eggs on the ground, try to keep the chickens in a fence to prevent them from running around, the eggs you pick up can be sold or cooked. You can also make chicken feeders. Go raise a group of cute chicks and enjoy the joy of picking eggs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/57f4e4983da14e468b482ca0be1576ba566f1d5f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Banana tree planting:[/h2]
When you cut down a banana tree, you can get a banana tree seedling, pay attention to it, it is very small, plant it on the plot, water it and grow up to get a big banana tree, you can harvest bananas and plants fiber. Banana trees take about 60 minutes to grow mature, peppers 30 minutes, and corn 40 minutes. Making fertilizers and putting them in the plot can increase the growth rate by 10 times, which means that it only takes a few minutes for the plants to grow mature after fertilizing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/e5b1e8505787d0d5d2058137cc1d00b56c15756c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/64bea8bb14d08f4f4073639bcfeb691e8ebaf60f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Corn planting:[/h2]
You need to buy corn seeds from the NPC of the starting island to plant. When they are mature, you can harvest corn and fiber. Corn can be eaten. You can also put corn in a stone mill or use a mortar to make shredded corn. Feed chickens and make chicken feeders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/214b881d808400974e7fb927a35de39c0930b305.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/4c89772f312e4cf29129cbda6988363838e6f766.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Reduces the spoilage speed of food, and they can be stored for a longer time after cooking. Usually, raw food can be stored for 1 hour, cooked food can be stored for 2 hours, and it can be kept fresh for the longest time in the fridge
[*] Increased the spoilage rate of the compost bin, which shortens the freshness of food by ten times, which can speed up the decay of coconuts and bananas, which can be used to make fertilizer.
[*] In order to make it easier to craft and prevent confusion, some buildings are removed from the workbench craft list, They are moved to the player craft list.
[*] Reduced the craft cost of items such as cloth, ropes,, Crop plots, building plan, etc., and increased the water capacity of WateringCan.
[*] Fixed the wrong materials required for many item crafting, The names of the carpets are changed
[*] Fixed the issue where hunger and thirst were still being consumed after players went offline to sleep in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Setting server password protection and name
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42377863/960b804ab13a1e8c9d3ab14b915202ac1e94b8b0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added server password protection function in multiplayer mode, as well as setting server name, maximum number of players, and server search function.
[*] The multiplayer mode is a personal computer as the server, other steam players can join, Its stability depends on your network. You must set a server name, otherwise other players won't be able to see your server. You can set a password to prevent other players from disturbing. You can tell your friends the password to join the game. All player data for this server is stored on your computer.
[*] If you want to open your server, just re-create the server name and set it to open state, it will not affect the archive of the multiplayer mode, other steam players can see your server name and then join.
[*] Note: If the server name is in Chinese,or the language of some countries, it will display garbled characters, which is caused by the built-in ANSI encoding of the engine source code instead of UFT8 encoding. No solution has been found yet. For the time being, you can set the letters or number, and the English server name.
[/list]
